what_they_did: Jan 3-7 2026 SW Berlin blackout (arson; 100k+ people, longest post-war outage): BVG reported no impact on operations and deployed heated buses as warming/phone-charging shelters; city commissioned a resilience expert report
lesson_for_madrid: Buses are a civil-protection asset; an all-BEV fleet needs depot backup power/storage to keep that role. Mirrors Madrid's Apr 2025 blackout where CNG buses carried record ridership

what_they_did: RATP signed a dedicated partnership with Enedis (distribution network operator) to connect converted bus depots to the public grid
lesson_for_madrid: Formal framework agreement with the DSO (i-DE/UFD/e-distribución) before depot-by-depot works

what_they_did: Garage-by-garage connections by UKPN; ~9+ months per garage (e.g. Sutton +3.8 MW incl. 1.5 km HV cable)
lesson_for_madrid: Put connection lead times on the critical path; start applications before buses are ordered

what_they_did: Mapped medium-voltage substation reserves (MVA bands) against each current/future depot before planning e-bus depots
lesson_for_madrid: Same method as File 3 connection_mw_estimate proxy - citeable precedent for the node-matching approach

what_they_did: Two Bluebus 5SE fires Apr 2022 (thermal runaway per BEA-TT); 149 buses grounded, ~232 RATP Bluebus out of service until 2024; manufacturer later exited market
lesson_for_madrid: Single-model fleet concentration is an availability risk: dual-source tenders + reserve buffer; supplier-exit risk

what_they_did: Garage fires (Potters Bar 2023, Putney Jan 2024); fleet-wide precautionary withdrawals; LFB objected to an underground e-bus garage beneath housing at Edgware
lesson_for_madrid: Avoid underground/covered dense charging; fire engineering affects depot capacity (Fleet_d) and Las Tablas design

what_they_did: 4 MW / 4.6 MWh battery at Alsterdorf depot: peak-shaving in winter, market trading in summer; Meiendorf e-depot with PV roofs
lesson_for_madrid: Storage turns an Upgrade depot into Ready without waiting for grid works and can earn revenue

what_they_did: Zenobe installed depot battery storage where grid import capacity limited simultaneous charging (Walworth; Southall)
lesson_for_madrid: Storage as a grid-constraint workaround under a third-party service model

what_they_did: RATP signed a PPA with Suez for ~100 GWh/yr renewable power for up to 16 years (2025), after an earlier EDF wind PPA
lesson_for_madrid: Long-term fixed-price power hedges opex - absent from the brief's capex-only view

what_they_did: Zenobe 14-year battery managed service guaranteeing on-board battery performance (Transport UK London Bus)
lesson_for_madrid: Contract battery performance for the asset life rather than owning mid-life replacement risk

what_they_did: HSL aims to include battery-manufacturing emissions in life-cycle assessment for future tenders
lesson_for_madrid: Supports disclosing lifecycle vs tank-to-wheel CO2 boundary in the report

what_they_did: Operators scored in tenders on fuel consumption, driver-behaviour monitoring, local/CO2 emissions and noise
lesson_for_madrid: Tender scoring is a lever beyond the bus price

what_they_did: Denmark bought only zero-emission city buses in 2025; Copenhagen city routes reached 100% ZE in Mar 2026 via line-by-line retendering
lesson_for_madrid: Contract cycles drive sequencing; national ZE-only procurement removes the CNG-replacement option

what_they_did: STIB used the first delivered eCitaro G to train technical, driving, dispatch and supervisory staff before rollout
lesson_for_madrid: Build a training lead time into each delivery batch

what_they_did: Stella project: pantograph fast chargers at up to 20 termini; without top-ups buses would be limited to ~250 km
lesson_for_madrid: Termini top-up is how Berlin handles long blocks - analogue for Madrid's Opportunity lines

what_they_did: Articulated eCitaro G (~200 km range) charge overnight in depot plus ~6-minute top-up at line termini
lesson_for_madrid: Articulated range is the binding case - same as Madrid's 240 km fixed range

what_they_did: Zenobe turnkey deals: finances vehicles and builds depot charging (169 buses, Transport UK, 4 depots ready Q1 2027); committed finance framework for Go-Ahead (280+ buses)
lesson_for_madrid: Capex can move off the operator's balance sheet - relevant to S1 'what would need to change'

what_they_did: TfL runs a separate rail-replacement qualification system and contracts replacement buses per closure (e.g. Piccadilly line weekends awarded to London General)
lesson_for_madrid: Contract out replacement services instead of drawing on the core (electrifying) fleet

what_they_did: Superloop express network (10 routes, +6M km/yr); pantograph rapid charging installed on one of the longest routes (358)
lesson_for_madrid: Network redesign and charging were planned together on long routes

what_they_did: STIB depot electrification (Petite-Ile) connects chargers to STIB's own internal 11 kV high-voltage network
lesson_for_madrid: Integrated multimodal operators can share HV networks; Madrid's Metro (regional) and EMT (municipal) are separate - an institutional barrier to name

what_they_did: Hochbahn (also U-Bahn operator) integrates depot storage into its own 20 kV medium-voltage depot network
lesson_for_madrid: Same integrated-operator advantage
